precedence: Overrides only EB residual-source definition and EB grouping-key authority. All previously frozen feature sets, CatBoost roles/configs, folds, target, race-head, PL, R1/R2/S2, bootstrap, and probability floors remain unchanged.

eb_residual.prediction_definition: fhat_ri is the raw CatBoostRegressor prediction from the outer-fold selected Primary GBDT candidate, on the z target scale, before any EB effect, PL temperature, race-head temperature adjustment, or probability transformation.

outer_train_inner_oof.candidate: the single M1-M4 Primary candidate selected for that outer fold under the frozen inner-OOF NLL rule
outer_train_inner_oof.prediction: For each inner-OOF target year y, fit that selected candidate only on its frozen prefix years < y and predict year y. Use those predictions to compute e_ri.
outer_train_inner_oof.eligible_years: 2021 through outer-TRAIN end; 2020 has no OOF residual

outer_valid_prediction_and_update.gbdt_fit: After candidate selection, fit one selected Primary GBDT on all outer-TRAIN rows. Do not refit GBDT during outer VALID.
outer_valid_prediction_and_update.prediction_before_date_d: For every outer-VALID runner on date d, compute fhat_ri from that fixed outer-TRAIN GBDT and apply the EB state frozen before date d.
outer_valid_prediction_and_update.residual_after_date_d_results: After all races on date d are scored and their results become available for evaluation, compute e_ri = z_ri - fhat_ri for date-d runners using the same fixed outer-TRAIN GBDT prediction. Only then update EB state; the update may affect dates > d only.

eb_residual.clipping: NONE beyond the already-frozen clipping of z_ri
eb_residual.target_training_weight_note: The Primary GBDT target/sample-weight contract remains 1/n_r exactly as already frozen. This amendment does not change or reinterpret EB aggregation weights.

horse.canonical_rule: use exact stored TEXT value; no name-based reconstruction
horse.validation: must match horses.horse_key through the existing FK for every modeling row

jockey.canonical_rule: Use the exact stored jockey TEXT token. Do not concatenate jockey_affiliation. Do not Unicode-normalize, alias-merge, case-fold, abbreviate, or construct a new ID.
jockey.missing_rule: SQL NULL or empty/whitespace-only jockey => MISSING_JOCKEY. MISSING_JOCKEY receives jockey main effect 0 and jockey×venue effect 0 and is excluded from jockey variance-component/group statistics; do not pool missing rows into a learned group.

venue.validation: Across the Job004 universe, venue_code must map one-to-one to races.venue and resolve to exactly the four South-Kanto venues represented by the accepted universe.

interactions.horse_venue: tuple(horse_key, venue_key); do not build a delimiter-concatenated string key
interactions.jockey_venue: tuple(jockey_key, venue_key) for non-missing jockey_key only; missing jockey gives zero interaction

eb_fit_algorithm_bindings.inheritance_rule: All EB backfit order, group means, sigma2, tau2, n_g definitions, centering, convergence and shrinkage formulas are inherited unchanged from MODEL_EVALUATION_FREEZE_V1. Amendment 004 changes none of them.
eb_fit_algorithm_bindings.residual_input_to_existing_algorithm: Use e_ri = z_ri - fhat_ri as the residual observation.
eb_fit_algorithm_bindings.cross_venue_identifiability: Retain the previously frozen rule: interaction is 0 where parent cross-venue identifiability is absent. Key membership is defined by this amendment.
